title: WPMS/3275/2019 of NEERAJ KUMAR SAINI Vs NEETU VERMA

paras.text:
WPMS No. 3275 of 2019
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Rajat Mittal, learned counsel for the
petitioner.
Petitioner is aggrieved by order dated
25.09.2019 passed by Principal Judge, Family
Court, Dehradun in Original Suit No. 920 of
2016. Petitioner has filed a suit under Section 12
of Hindu Marriage Act, which is pending before
Principal Judge, Family Court, Dehradun. After
exchange of pleadings in the said suit and after
close of plaintiff's evidence on 28.08.2019,
learned Family Court fixed 25.09.2019 for further
evidence, if any, on behalf of the plaintiff. On
that day, learned counsel appearing for the
plaintiff before Family Court, however, made an
endorsement in the order-sheet that he does not
want to lead any further evidence. Subsequently,
plaintiff/petitioner moved an application on the
same day i.e. 25.09.2019 seeking permission to
lead further evidence. Learned Family Court vide
order dated 25.09.2019 closed petitioner's
opportunity to lead evidence fixing 30.10.2019.
Thus, feeling aggrieved, petitioner has
approached this Court.
Since petitioner has remedy of filing an
application seeking recall of the order dated
25.09.2019, which he has not availed before
approaching this Court, therefore, this Court is
not inclined to interfere with the matter.
In such view of the matter, writ petition is
disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to
approach learned Family Court seeking recall of
the order dated 25.09.2019. If such an
application is made within ten days from today,
then learned Principal Judge, Family Court,
Dehradun shall consider the same and pass
appropriate order, in accordance with law, within
four weeks thereafter. Till disposal of petitioner's
application, proceedings of Original Suit No. 920
of 2016 shall be kept in abeyance.
Let certified copy of this order be supplied
to the petitioner within 24 hours.
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.)
22.10.2019
Aswal
